text: Hirnikel, Daniel J.; Poget, Laurent; Lau, Raymond; 'Ulrich Kreuter'
Review of test protocol for SmokeStation test
Please find attached our a draft test protocol of the SmokeStation test for your review.
In brief, this test is to determine the effective ventilation rate (EVR) as previously described
by Bohanon at IAQ 99 (see attached pdf). Most unfortunately, this paper is pretty confusing
(so that I and Dr. Kreuter couldn't totally figure out what's going on) and I would need your
input (see chapter 3, pink insert). Also, please fill in some brief statements where indicated.
It looks as if everybody is on board for the measurements in Richmond, starting Monday
March 20th till Friday 24th. Since we are running out of time I would be grateful for your
review by March 6. Further details on our programme in Richmond will follow shortly.
